question: When does the Raksha Bandhan fall according to the Hindu calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shravana Poornima (Shukla)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Raksha Bandhan or Rakhi Purnima is celebrated on the full moon day, or Purnima tithi, according to the Hindu calendar.
 
• It is observed during the Shravana month.
 
• Hindus celebrate Raksha Bandhan every year as a well-known and customary ritual or celebration.
 
• On this day, sisters of all ages wrap their brothers' wrists with a charm or amulet known as the Rakhi.
 
• They give them a present in exchange for protecting them figuratively, share some of the burdens of their potential care with the brothers, and symbolically protect them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shravana Poornima: **Celebrated in the month of Shravan, it's dedicated to Lord Shiva. Devotees perform special prayers and rituals in Shiva temples. Raksha Bandhan, the festival of sibling bonds, is also observed on this day.
 
• **Kartika Poornima:** Coincides with Diwali, the festival of lights. It's also known as Deva-Diwali, the festival of lights for the gods. People worship deities and light lamps on this day.
 
• **Phalguna Poornima:** Occurs in the month of Phalguna, preceding the Holi festival. It's a day of prayer and preparation before the Holi celebrations.
 
• **Bhadrapada Poornima:** Falls in the month of Bhadrapada, after Ganesh Chaturthi. In some regions, it's celebrated as Narali Purnima, marking the end of the monsoon season.
